predecessors.name: Weimar Republic
predecessors.text: the German area north of the Memel River, East Prussia's Memelland, detached by the Treaty of Versailles

successors.name: Lithuania, 1918-1940 (Cliopatria's 'Kingdom of Lithuania' row)
successors.text: the Klaipėda Region, annexed by Lithuania in January 1923 and made 'an autonomous region under unconditional sovereignty of Lithuania' by the May 1924 convention

ledger.x: 15 February 1920: France takes over the Memel Territory.
15 February 1920: French troops and High Commissioner Dominique Odry administer the territory for the Allied powers.
January 1923: French rule ends in practice.
19 January 1923: the Memel Territory passes to Lithuania.
January 1923: the Memel Territory ceases to be a separate territory and is incorporated into Lithuania as an autonomous district.

wars.name: Klaipėda Revolt
wars.outcome: Lithuanian volunteers overthrow the French administration in January 1923 and the region is incorporated into Lithuania (annexed 19 January, accepted by the Seimas 24 January, transferred by the Conference of Ambassadors 17 February 1923, convention of May…

certainty.note: The frontier is the Versailles line 'north of the Memel River' with Germany, and the Lithuanian frontier of the former German district; the 30 km circle is only an approximation of it.
